title: Request indexing opens the right Google account
changes: The Request indexing buttons (11:30 email and CMS > Indexing) open Search Console in runonconsole@gmail.com, so Chrome with several Google accounts no longer shows a Google 404 page
When Google says the daily check quota is used up (error 429), the indexing checker waits until Google resets it (13:00 Pakistan time) instead of asking every 10 minutes
An old problem message in CMS > Indexing goes away once the checks work again
steps: Upload the zip to /home2/runoncon/ and unzip it.
